description: Converts a Claude Code skills repository into an official plugin marketplace by generating a validated, install-tested .claude-plugin/marketplace.json.

evals.name: Create marketplace.json for a new skills repo
evals.prompt: I have a repo with a skills/ directory containing several SKILL.md files but no marketplace.json yet. Write the .claude-plugin/marketplace.json that would register this as a single-skill plugin for the skill at skills/example-tool/SKILL.md (name: example-tool, description: 'Does an example thing'). Show me the exact JSON you'd write and explain your field choices.
evals.expected_output: A marketplace.json with no $schema field, metadata containing only description/version/pluginRoot, strict: false, source pointing directly at the skill directory (not skills: ["./"]), and version "1.0.0" for the new plugin entry.

evals.name: Debug a claude plugin validate failure
evals.prompt: My marketplace.json has this plugin entry and `claude plugin validate` fails: {"name": "my-tool", "source": "./my-tool", "strict": false, "$schema": "https://schemas.anthropic.com/marketplace.json", "metadata": {"homepage": "https://example.com"}}. What's wrong and how do I fix it?
evals.expected_output: Correctly identifies both the rejected $schema field and the non-existent metadata.homepage field (metadata only has description/version/pluginRoot) as the causes, and gives the corrected JSON.

evals.name: Add a skill to an existing marketplace and bump version
evals.prompt: I just added a new skill directory skills/new-helper/ to my skills repo, which already has a working marketplace.json for a suite plugin at ./tools (with a skills array). The plugin's current version in marketplace.json is "1.2.0". What do I need to change in marketplace.json?
evals.expected_output: Adds "new-helper" to the plugin's skills array and explicitly calls out bumping the plugin's version field (e.g. to 1.3.0) so users on the old cached version receive the update — doesn't just add the skill entry silently.
